# اعتماد ملل | Etemad Melal

> پلتفرم مشارکت مدنی در پروژه‌های صنعتی و بازرگانی، با پنل کاربری اختصاصی — etemadmelal.com

## About (English)

Etemad Melal is a Persian (RTL) marketing website for a civil partnership platform that connects small-scale capital with industrial and commercial projects. All activity is concluded under a civil partnership contract combined with agency (Articles 10, 571 and 656 of Iran's Civil Code). Registration, identity verification, choosing a partnership plan, profit tracking, and withdrawals happen in the separate user panel at https://panel.etemadmelal.com — not on this marketing site.

Legal entity: شرکت خلاقان اعتماد ملل دیبا (Etemad Melal Creative Trust Diba Co.), Mashhad, Iran.
Contact: info@etemadmelal.com

Positioning: architect of the link between capital and industry — aggregating micro-capital into productive industrial projects.

## درباره (فارسی)

اعتماد ملل وب‌سایت معرفی و آموزش پلتفرم مشارکت مدنی است. ثبت‌نام، احراز هویت، انتخاب طرح مشارکت مدنی، پیگیری حق مشارکت، گزارش پاداش‌ها و درخواست برداشت فقط از پنل کاربری انجام می‌شود.

Participation amounts, plans, returns, and contract terms are shown in the user panel after sign-in — the marketing site does not list them. Periodic payments are "on-account" (علی‌الحساب) and are settled at the end of each period based on the projects' actual performance.

## Benefits (منافع / دو رکن)

The «اعتماد ملل» financial structure rests on two pillars, both founded on contractual participation and operational transparency:

1. **مشارکت در بازدهی صنعتی** — directing small capital into the real value chain and productive projects, away from speculative volatility.
2. **پاداش توسعه بازار** — rewards based on real performance in introducing the platform and developing business connections (a ju'alah under Article 561 of the Civil Code).

Note: marketing copy uses «پاداش» (reward), not «پورسانت» (commission).
